steps.note: Start the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to a single-stage rank auction with whole-lot awarding.
Apply the first available auction template; the exact forward/sell template direction is not expressible.
Add the requested product as one line item with quantity 10.

args.goal: on the single-stage create screen, set the first line item's plant or delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Terms & Conditions, add the two requested clauses, mark all clauses mandatory, and stop with the saved terms and location visible

steps.note: Configure the plant location and mandatory event terms, which have no dedicated catalog steps.
Invite one QA test vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Verify that publishing reached a real event page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the published auction's vendor bidding sheet.
Accept the first mandatory terms clause before bidding.
Accept the second mandatory terms clause before bidding.
Submit the vendor's bid of 100 after accepting all mandatory clauses.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page to check the resulting event state.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.
